bagPolicy.summary: Only very small handbags or purses under 10 x 10 x 6 inches are allowed, and large bags, large purses and backpacks are prohibited. Anything larger has to be checked at coat check, and all small bags and jackets may be searched.
allowed: Small handbags or purses under 10 x 10 x 6 in
bagPolicy.quote: We allow only VERY small handbags (purses) smaller than 10"x10"x6".

parking.summary: A paid guest lot off 14th Avenue is available after 6 pm. Guests with an ADA placard can park free in the guest lot attached to the building.
parking.quote: If you have an ADA placard you may park in the guest lot attached to the building for free.

rideshare.summary: Revolution Hall asks guests to take a taxi or rideshare for safety. No dedicated pickup zone is published, so set your pickup to the venue's address.
rideshare.quote: we request you and your group take a taxi or rideshare in the interest of safety

concessions.summary: Food and drinks bought at the bars and cafe in the building are allowed in the venue for most shows, but no glass cups. Outside alcohol is prohibited.
concessions.quote: Any food and beverage purchased at any of our bars and cafe in the building are allowed in the venue for most shows.

accessibility.summary: For accommodations, email info@revhallpdx.com with the show and date you have tickets for. Guests with an ADA placard can park free in the guest lot attached to the building.
accessibility.quote: Please contact us at info@revhallpdx.com and provide us with the show and date you have purchased tickets for.

reEntry.summary: Revolution Hall hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is on the first floor near the main entrance, and tickets can also be bought at the Etix self-serve kiosks at Show Bar. Valid ID is required for all 21+ shows, anyone who looks under 26 will be carded, and photocopies or digital images of ID aren't accepted.
ticketPickup.quote: VALID ID REQUIRED FOR ALL 21+ SHOWS PER OLCC REGULATION.

gates.summary: Most events list both a door time and a start time. The box office and coat check are on the first floor near the main entrance.
gates.quote: Most events have a door time and start time listed.
